description: Ranch Country 2040 — drought + ag flags on, full session lifecycle to max_year=2040
notes: ag_digest_md5 changed from 756ec0d2d5ddf481be1331a48b38a1cb (energy-only value) to 0c537942942e306a22f04bdc44418b07 when the drought trajectory ordering bug was fixed.

Previously, applySessionDrought ran AFTER engineAdvanceYear, so advanceCountyAg recorded trajectory snapshots before seeing drought events — making drought-enabled ag_digest identical to energy-only. Now drought is applied first (targetYear = state.year + 1) so trajectories correctly capture drought-affected forage values in the year the drought occurs.
replay_digest is unchanged because it covers county_ees/bus_state/couplings/sc_pools, none of which are affected by drought ordering.
